args.summary: Following the deployment of v2.3.1, checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Per runbook, rolled back all regions to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0 (last healthy at seq 1). Rollback completed successfully; all regions now running v2.3.0, service is healthy again with error rate back to ~0.2%. v2.3.1 requires investigation before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: All regions rolled back to v2.3.0. Verified post-rollback: all regions running v2.3.0, healthy, error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and current healthy state. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so any attempt to redeploy it will require change-manager approval per policy.
